order_note: No predecessor. SQL 174 creates one function and replaces nothing (owner 2026-11-24, "start step 3": clear the one stranded CheckAlt deposit attempt). Before PR 2068, checkalt-submit.mjs ran markHttpAttempted before the Check Alt sign-in; the sign-in answered 504 at 2026-11-24 19:58 UTC ("CheckAlt auth failed [504]", CloudWatch 19:58:54 UTC), no POST /fincapture/deposit/process was sent (the owner confirmed in the Check Alt portal that no deposit went through), and the attempt row stayed status submitting with provider_http_attempted_at set and the payload flag provider_http_attempted true, so every later press answers reconciliation_required. The read-only inspect of PR 2067 (checkalt-deposit-state-inspect, SSM 9eb0173e-0540-467f-b108-8fb6edc727e2, source commit 07068a8a) found exactly one such row of 92. One new SECURITY DEFINER function, public.aws_checkalt_reset_stranded_attempt(timestamp with time zone, timestamp with time zone) returning integer (plpgsql, VOLATILE, search_path public, pg_temp, row_security off, EXECUTE for the owner only: revoked from PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role and checksops). In a window of at most one hour it locks and counts the attempts with checkalt_reference NULL, status submitting, provider_http_attempted_at and created_at in the window, failure_class NULL, last_error NULL, last_status_payload phase submitting, a check with deposited_at NULL and no other checkalt_deposits row for that check; more than one raises 55000 sql174_ambiguous_stranded_attempts (nothing changes), none returns 0 (a NOTICE says whether a row of the window is already reset), exactly one is set back to the state insertQueuedDeposit leaves (status queued, provider_http_attempted_at NULL, last_status_payload merged with phase queued_before_http, provider_http_attempted false and stranded_reset {reason pre_provider_sign_in_504, migration 174, at now()}, updated_at now(); checkalt_reference stays NULL, amount, amount_cents, idempotency_key, tenant_id, check_intake_item_id and submitted_by untouched) and it returns 1. The file calls it once for [2026-11-24 19:58:00+00, 2026-11-24 19:59:00+00). It names no id, amount or name. The four status triggers on checkalt_deposits (SQL 120, 121, 123, 152) write nothing for submitting -> queued. The file refuses (55000) sql174_prerequisite_missing and sql174_definer_cannot_read (the applying login must own checkalt_deposits and check_intake_items without FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, or be a superuser or BYPASSRLS; the engine's definer_can_write_relations). Before the file runs the engine requires checkalt_stranded_attempt_in_window: on production the declared count checkalt_stranded_attempts_in_window (the function's own rule for that minute, aggregate only) must be exactly 1; on staging it must be 0. Expected catalog pre-state in both environments: the function absent (release sql174 v1: 51db2d269aed8dc824b02831671c6e945fde3cd2d772e167e6ea6bfe6824e83f, releaseStateHash('sql174', {})). No API, Lambda or SPA change is part of this pin.
